'''Gleeson Wells''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] in the [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]]. Sometime after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Wells was servicing some [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] in the Processing Facility's [[Armor/Legends|armory]] when he encountered a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents that had [[Mission to Tazan|infiltrated]] the base. Wells attacked the agents with a [[Screwdriver/Legends|screwdriver]] and attempted to make his way to the base's guardroom, so that he could raise the alarm.
